purpose: Locate an event relative to a situation or action.
keywords: Plain verb / い-adjective + とき; noun + のとき; な-adjective + なとき.
I read when I have free time.
I check my key when leaving home.
I lived near the sea when I was a child.
formation: Plain verb / い-adjective + とき; noun + のとき; な-adjective + なとき.
restrictions: Verb tense before とき expresses the action’s stage relative to the main event.
mistake: Use 学生のとき, not 学生とき.
